evidence.heading: Useful evidence has limits.
evidence.text: INTERPRETATION BEFORE ANALYSISSource qualificationshandling: Original source rows and values retained. No interpolation, gap filling or averaging is applied at import. Identical weather files remain traceable source channels and are identified as copies.gap rule: Steps longer than one hour are flagged for sensor and weather channels. Setpoint histories are controller events and are excluded from this cadence rule. This is a descriptive application rule, not a commissioning specification.outdoor data: One external virtual weather series is repeated under six room filenames; it is not six independent physical outdoor sensors.calibration: No device calibration or measurement accuracy is independently established by this application.sensor locations: The IFC contains no IfcSensor instances. Associations terminate at actual IfcSpace GUIDs; sensor positions and device GUIDs are not invented.
